question_stem: A polished sheet of magnesium in a vacuum emits electrons when it is illuminated by ultraviolet radiation.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State the name of this phenomenon.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem: For emission of electrons to occur, the frequency of the ultraviolet radiation must be at least $8.8 \times 10^{14} \text{Hz}$.
parts.text: Calculate the work function energy of magnesium.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: For ultraviolet radiation with a frequency of $11 \times 10^{14} \text{Hz}$, calculate the maximum speed of the emitted electrons.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The frequency $f$ of the ultraviolet radiation incident on the magnesium sheet is varied between $8.0 \times 10^{14} \text{Hz}$ and $11 \times 10^{14} \text{Hz}$.

On Fig. 8.1, sketch the variation with $f$ of the maximum kinetic energy $E_{\text{MAX}}$ of the emitted electrons. Use the space below for any working that you need.
